name: Rek'Sai
notes: We use Rek'Sai's Unburrowed kit throughout: Queen's Wrath (Q), Furious Bite (E), and Unburrow's damage burst (W). Prey Seeker, Tunnel and the Burrowed form of Q are never used since they trade damage for utility this fight has no use for.

Fury starts at 0 and accumulates during the fight: 25 per basic-attack hit and 25 per damaging ability hit (Unburrow, Furious Bite, Void Rush), capped at 100; Queen's Wrath itself grants no Fury, per the wiki. Out-of-combat Fury decay (after 8s) never triggers since Rek'Sai is attacking or casting continuously.

Furious Bite's 1.2x true-damage conversion is read as binary: it only applies once Fury is exactly at its 100 cap, matching the wiki's 'at maximum Fury' wording; below that it is plain physical damage.

Queen's Wrath (Q) carries no flat base damage: the sheet's RekSaiQ#TotalDamageTooltip formula and the wiki's own damage line both give only the AD-ratio term, so UnburrowedBaseDamage is treated as unused data.

Queen's Wrath is cast on cooldown; it grants 35% bonus attack speed and empowers up to 3 subsequent basic attacks (refreshing a 3s window each time one lands), and resets Rek'Sai's attack timer on cast. Its cooldown starts only once that window ends (post-effect), matching the sheet's cdstart. Queen's Wrath has no cast time (the sheet and wiki both say 'none'), so it costs no time itself and does not block Furious Bite's cast.
Queen's Wrath's bonus damage to the primary target is crit-eligible; there is no second target in a single-dummy fight so only the primary hit is modeled.

W bundles the Burrow->Unburrow toggle into one instant action on Unburrow's 4s cooldown: Burrow itself has no cast time or damage and its cooldown only starts once Unburrow is subsequently cast, so the pair is treated as a single cooldown-gated burst. Unburrow does not count as an ability activation, so it does not trigger Spellblade/Muramana/Eclipse-style on-cast procs, per the wiki, though its hit still deals magic ability damage and generates Fury. It also applies a short 0.15s attack/move lockout after landing.
Furious Bite is cast on cooldown (6s): it has a 0.25s cast time (gen.E.castTimeS) which keeps Rek'Sai busy (no other cast, no attack) until it ends, per the sheet and wiki.

Void Rush requires a target Marked as Prey, which only exists once Rek'Sai has already damaged the dummy; the fight opens with no mark, so Void Rush is held until the first hit lands (almost immediately, from the opening auto-attack) and then cast as soon as its long cooldown allows. Its cast time (0.35s, from the sheet, overriding the wiki's differing 0.25s display) keeps Rek'Sai busy, and its further 0.9s delay before the pounce lands (a wiki estimate with no corresponding bin value) holds attacks as well since she is vanished.
Mana is not modeled: none of Rek'Sai's abilities have a real cost that would bind inside a 15s fight.

assumed.why: the pounce delay after Void Rush's cast time has no bin value; using the wiki's estimated 0.9 seconds
